cohort: Refugee and non-refugee women delivering at St. Michael's Hospital in Toronto, between January 1, 2008, and December 31, 2010
finding: Multiparous refugee women and refugee women from Sub-Saharan Africa had significantly higher rates of adverse obstetric and perinatal outcomes compared to non-refugee women.
mod_finding: Multiparous refugee women had a significantly higher rate of delivery by Caesarean section compared with non-refugee women.
